2. In the instant petition, petitioner has prayed for the following relief(s):-
(i) To issue an appropriate writ/writs and direction/directions to the Respondents to give the compensation for the land measuring area 74 Decimals and 04 Squire Kari from Khesra No. 300, Khata No. 18 under Mauza Bhelaguri, Block Tedhagachh,
Thana No. 125, District Kishanganj and construction thereupon 04 rooms with Tin Roof, one Tub-well, 400 Bamboo Trees, 04 Mango Trees, 03 Jackfruit Trees and 02 Kadam Trees thereupon which has been acquired under Land Acquisition Case No.
05/2019-20 in Project "Araria-Galgalia New B.G. Rail Line" as the petitioner has not been given single penny for the compensation either for the land acquired or for the Patna High Court CWJC No.17122 of 2024(2) dt.12-11-2024 construction thereupon or for the trees thereupon or for the Tub-well thereupon;
(ii) For the direction/directions to the Respondents to give opportunity a fresh to the petitioner to challenge the process of fixing the compensation amount followed by the opportunity to enhance the compensation so fixed and paid as per the provisions of Thirani Sah vs The Union Of India on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102898645/
1 the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (the Act for the sake of brevity)
